## Shipyard

Shipyard is now a stable skill in `skills/dev/shipyard`, included in the Claude Code plugin and the skills catalog.

- Coordinate Codex and Claude Code with one primary dispatcher, bounded workers, and advisors when needed.
- Workers run relevant checks; CI handles full regression before merge. Verification, CI repair, and delivery have distinct roles.
- Choose model and effort automatically by task, with stage-specific parameter overrides and project, personal, task, or one-shot preferences.
- Preview, inspect, and reset settings through validated helpers with locked, backed-up atomic writes.
- Clean up confirmed merged task branches with checks for active worktrees, protected branches, and advanced refs.

## Install

Pick one installation route.

For Codex or a direct global skill installation:

```bash
npx skills@latest add itamaker/skills --skill=shipyard
```

Choose Global scope and the clients you use. Invoke `$shipyard` in Codex or `/shipyard` in Claude Code.

For the managed Claude Code plugin:

```text
/plugin marketplace add itamaker/skills
/plugin install itamaker-skills@itamaker
```

The plugin exposes `/itamaker-skills:shipyard`. Existing plugin users can update their marketplace and installed plugin to version 2.1.0.

## Native roles and upgrades

Native role setup is optional and explicit. It requires the direct global installation route because the templates reference user-global skill paths. Preview the bundled installer before applying it; see [client setup](https://github.com/itamaker/skills/blob/v2.1.0/skills/dev/shipyard/references/clients.md).

All role names use hyphens, including `verify-worker`, `ci-worker`, and `deliver-worker`. Saved underscore aliases remain readable. The native installer backs up recognized legacy Codex aliases and preserves unrelated files.

Model and effort settings apply to requested settings for future subagents. Actual application depends on client capabilities and must be confirmed through host metadata. Existing sessions are not hot-swapped.
